title: Sentinel — Runaway Agent Detection
description: Real-time monitoring of agent tool-call patterns, quarantines, and Sentinel circuit-breaker metrics. Import into SigNoz via Install API.

panels.title: Tool Calls / min by Agent
panels.description: Rate of MCP tool calls per agent (count per 60s). Spikes indicate potential runaway loops.

panels.title: Repeated Call Fingerprints
panels.description: Top (tool, args_hash) pairs sorted by repetition count. Values approaching 8 may trigger quarantine.

panels.title: Quarantine Count
panels.description: Number of credentials currently in quarantine state (status = quarantined).

panels.title: Total Quarantine Actions
panels.description: Cumulative number of quarantine actions executed (including repeats).

panels.title: Alert-to-Action Latency (p99)
panels.description: Latency from webhook receipt to quarantine action completion. P99 across recent window.

panels.title: Currently Quarantined Agents
panels.description: List of agent IDs currently under quarantine, with incident IDs and timestamps.

panels.title: Idempotency Key Hit Rate
panels.description: Shows duplicate vs new webhook requests. High duplicate rate means multiple alerts firing for same incident.

panels.title: Dry-Run / Live Quarantine Ratio
panels.description: Share of quarantine actions that were dry-run (no real revocation) vs live revocation.
